rationale: Price at $26.50 remains below both session VWAP ($26.55) and the 5m 9-EMA ($26.52), so the core short thesis (sellers in control below VWAP) is still technically intact, and the tight $26.55 invalidation caps risk at roughly $23 while take-profit targets ~$60. Although the bounce off the $26.27 low to the upper half of the range is a mild warning and the position sits just 5 cents from invalidation, the single flat 1m candle and absence of news give no mechanical trigger to close or flip, so maintaining the short with the existing enforced levels is the balanced action.
